config.simpleend.biomeChance.tooltip: Share of 72x72-chunk areas on the outer islands that hold one patch, 28-44 chunks across, spanning several islands (0 to 1). Default: 0.4.
config.simpleend.biomes.tooltip: Lets the two biomes (foggy core and fringe) replace large patches of the outer End islands in new chunks.
config.simpleend.budsGrowAlone.tooltip: Buds grow into trees on their own in light level 9 or more; bone meal always works.
config.simpleend.enableSimpleEndDragonFi: Turns the bundled sub-mod Simple End Dragon Fight on or off (only while Simple End itself is on).
config.simpleend.enabled.tooltip: Turns Simple End on or off. Off keeps all blocks and items, but buds stop growing and the biomes stop spreading into new chunks.
config.simpleend.longerDespawn.tooltip: Dropped End-wood items stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
config.simpleend.voidSafeItems.tooltip: Dropped End-wood items float back up when they fall below the world.
quests.simpleend.start.subtitle: Your free guide
quests.simpleend.start.title: Welcome to Simple End
quests.simpleend.start.welcome.descripti: Craft or pick up a crafting table and claim the Simple End Guide as a reward. You can also craft it from a book and a chorus fruit.
quests.simpleend.start.welcome.title: A free guide
simpleend.guide.page.1: Ashwood and Duskwood, buds that grow End trees or stick scrub, End grass and the Ash Valley and Dawnlands biomes on the outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.1.title: Simple End
simpleend.guide.page.10: below the world they float back up and hover just above the bottom. They also stay 10 instead of 5 minutes.
simpleend.guide.page.10.title: Void-safe wood
simpleend.guide.page.11: Wiry End grass and twiggy End bushes, like Vanilla dry grass and dead bushes, standing on End stone. They grow in Ash Valley and Dawnlands and sparsely on all outer End islands.
simpleend.guide.page.11.title: End grass and End bushes
simpleend.guide.page.12: Two large End biomes on the outer islands (never on the dragon island): rare patches 14-24 chunks across with a wavy rim replace the End highlands/midlands/barrens.
simpleend.guide.page.12.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.13: Each has a foggy core (Ash Valley, Dawnlands) inside a fringe (Ash Valley Fringe, Dawnlands Fringe).
simpleend.guide.page.13.title: Ash Valley and Dawnlands
simpleend.guide.page.14: A small, passive Endermite kin that lives in Ash Valley and Dawnlands in groups of 3-5, coloured after its biome (pale grey with lavender, taupe with rose). It nibbles End stone like sheep graze:
simpleend.guide.page.14.title: Nibblemite
simpleend.guide.page.15: the block under it becomes Burrowed End Stone, which turns back into End stone after a few minutes.
simpleend.guide.page.15.title: Nibblemite
simpleend.guide.page.16: SimpleBuilding bundles Simple End ("Enable Simple End"); Simple End bundles Simple End Dragon Fight ("Enable Simple End Dragon Fight" in config/simpleend.json). Each level has its own switch;
simpleend.guide.page.16.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.17: Dragon Fight runs only while Simple End is on. Simple End also plays alone.
simpleend.guide.page.17.title: Simple End and its sub-mod
simpleend.guide.page.2: Two End woods with the full Vanilla wood set:
simpleend.guide.page.2.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.3: log, wood, stripped log and wood, planks, stairs, slab, fence, fence gate, door, trapdoor, button, pressure plate, sign, hanging sign, shelf, leaves, boat and boat with chest.
simpleend.guide.page.3.title: Ashwood and Duskwood
simpleend.guide.page.4: Ash Bud and Dusk Bud grow on End stone or dirt. Outside the End, in light 9 or more, a bud becomes a gigantic wood tree; in the dark bone meal turns it into stick scrub.
simpleend.guide.page.4.title: Buds, gigantic End trees and stick trees
simpleend.guide.page.5: In the End every bud grows a stick tree - wood comes only from buds planted outside the End.
simpleend.guide.page.5.title: Buds, gigantic End trees and stick trees
simpleend.guide.page.6: End leaves are no full block: a see-through star of tendrils around a small crystal, tinted
simpleend.guide.page.6.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.7: by the biome. Only the few leaves a tree marked drop its bud or fruit (always);
simpleend.guide.page.7.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.8: all drop sticks now and then. Drift Fruit ripens only in the End - elsewhere the fruit is Spoiled Drift Fruit. Ashwood leaves act like a cobweb.
simpleend.guide.page.8.title: Leaves, Drift Fruit and Spoiled Drift Fruit
simpleend.guide.page.9: Dropped End-wood items (logs, planks, everything of the sets, buds, End grass, Drift Fruit) are not lost in the void:
simpleend.guide.page.9.title: Void-safe wood
